messages:
Ashley (sales): Prospect (regional bank) wants a short POC for BYO-KMS/HSM. They asked: perf impact, rough egress cost, firewall/IPs, and answers for their security questionnaire. Need a one-pager for procurement.
Ben (platform): BYO adds an auth + network hop for envelope unwraps. Ballpark extra latency 10-40ms depending on RTT. Mitigate with DEK cache (local sidecar) and short TTL.
Claire (crypto): Compliance check: confirm FIPS attestation / dual-custody need. Recommend DEK cache TTL 5m, LRU cap per-tenant (e.g., 1k), and KEK rotation policy (customer-driven). Include revocation playbook.
Devon (solutions): Will produce a tiny perf harness and simple curl test they can run from their network. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Redwood-BYO: true" \
  -d @payload.json
```
Run 1k requests at concurrency 8 and report p50/p95. We can offer a 1hr on-call during tests.
Ben (platform): For firewall: outbound HTTPS (443) to their KMS IPs; support mTLS if they require it. I'll draft a one-page ip list + sample iptables and a cost sensitivity table (per-100k unwraps estimate).
ops-bot: Ticket created #SUP-2133 assigned Devon (solutions)  POC planner due 72h.
Ashley (sales): Action: Devon -> harness + instructions; Ben -> ports/iplist + cost table; Claire -> compliance FAQ + rotation notes. I'll bundle into a concise POC one-pager and send to the prospect.
